title: House Rules
installation: Mac: HouseRulesDemo.app. The app isn’t signed by Apple, so the first time, right-click it and choose Open.
overview: You’ve just inherited an apartment complex, but you have to keep it occupied or lose it. Soon you’re overrun with beautiful tenants, each with their own agenda. Meanwhile, a sleazy developer is undermining you at every turn. You must save the building, set the rules… and find out which rules are worth breaking!

title: The Hollow Hunt
language: English, Turkish, Russian, French, Spanish, Japanese, Portuguese
overview: Vellmoor is a poor village on the edge of the Black Forest, ruled by the cold and harsh Baron Ostric. Young women are disappearing, and a killer with a lantern walks the woods at night. Teodric is a former clerk, a fearful man haunted by his past. His wife Liva is the opposite: a forester’s daughter, brave, sharp with a sword, and the most beautiful woman in the village. Every man in Vellmoor has his eyes on her, and many don’t hide it. When the Baron sends them to hunt the killer, he gives them a third companion: Lucan, the best sword in the village and its worst character. In front of Teodric he plays the loyal friend. The moment Teodric looks away, the mask comes off. Dark medieval mystery and horror, with a card-based battle system.

title: 8 Weeks
overview: Overview: 8 Weeks is a visual novel about returning home after years away and trying to start over. Back in your hometown, you reconnect with people from your past and meet new ones, while your brother’s problems slowly begin to become your own. Every woman you meet has her own personality, past, and secrets waiting to be discovered. Each one has something to reveal. Your choices shape the relationships you build with the women around you, changing how they see you and how close they let you get.

title: Pinked and Owned
installation: 1. Play directly in the browser, or
2. Download the Windows Portable ZIP (extract anywhere, run the .exe), or
3. Sideload the Android APK (enable Install Unknown Apps in system settings once, then tap the APK).
overview: Pinked and Owned is an adult HTML/browser narrative game about slow feminization and a life quietly rearranging itself. You play a guy with a small chastity cage, a complicated roommate, and the kind of job that keeps asking him to wear something new. Stat-driven sandbox, explore the city, build (or lose) your resolve, and watch the story branch based on choices you didn’t even realise were choices. Active solo dev, new content every 2-3 weeks.
